questions.question: Whom is the LORD praised for lifting up in Psalm 113?
options: The wandering from the desert and the lost from the sea
The poor from the dust and the needy from the ash heap
The righteous from the grave and the faithful from death
The exiles from Babylon and the captives from afar
questions.answer: The poor from the dust and the needy from the ash heap

questions.question: From where to where is the name of the LORD to be praised?
options: Within the gates of Zion alone
From the rising of the sun to its setting
From the early morning until the late evening
Only in the courts of the temple
questions.answer: From the rising of the sun to its setting

questions.question: The psalm says God gives the barren woman a home, making her the joyous mother of children.
Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and _____!
He raises the poor from the _____ and lifts the needy from the ash heap.
